summary: Vue component `back-top`, a scroll-to-top button. It renders a `button.backTop` with the `backTop--show` modifier and the `theme` prop (default `light`) as classes; it listens to window `scroll` (bound on mount, removed before destroy) and shows itself once the scroll offset exceeds half the viewport height, and on click animates `html,body` to `scrollTop: 0` with jQuery and tracks `back_to_top` via `$trackButton`.

exports.a: the back-top Vue component (normalized component exports)
